description.zh: 演练ID。您可以通过[DescribeReplicaGroupDrills](~~2584481~~)接口查询当前地域下复制对的容灾演练。
description.en: The ID of the drill. You can call the [DescribeReplicaGroupDrills](~~2584481~~) operation to query disaster recovery drills that were performed on replication pairs in a specific region.

description.zh: 复制组ID。您可以通过[DescribeDiskReplicaGroups](~~426614~~)接口查询异步复制组列表，获得复制组ID。
description.en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. You can call the [DescribeDiskReplicaGroups](~~426614~~) operation to query the most recent list of replication pair-consistent groups, including group IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~354276~~)查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) operation to query the most recent list of regions in which async replication is supported.

title.zh: 清理异步复制组的容灾演练

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs clear-replica-group-drill --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id pg-xxxx --drill-id pg-drill-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
